(ii) was or becomes available to you on a non-confidential BASIS from a source other than the Company or its representatives, provided that such source is not prohibited from disclosing such information to you by a contractual, legal or fiduciary obligation to the Company or its representatives, or

The term "Evaluation Materials" includes information furnished to you orally or in writing (whatever the form or storage medium) or gathered by inspection,and regardless of whether such information is specifically identified as "confidential."
